profile.headline: Application Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
profile.intro: I build web applications, develop Roblox experiences, and support IT operations. My work connects business needs with structured technical solutions.
profile.about: My experience includes application development, testing, deployment, performance optimization, Linux server administration, networking, and technical support. I collaborate with cross-functional teams to turn requirements into usable applications.

exp-1.description: Developed games and interactive experiences on the Roblox platform as a freelancer.

exp-2.description: Developed frontend applications using Next.js and backend services using NestJS. Collaborated with cross-functional teams and product managers, integrated data sources, created Jasper Reports, and troubleshot application issues.

exp-3.description: Built a Client Request System using Laravel and MySQL, RESTful APIs, and responsive interfaces using Bootstrap and jQuery. Performed testing, debugging, and performance optimization.

exp-4.description: Developed and deployed applications with PHP and Laravel. Optimized existing application code, performed functional tests, and debugged issues.

exp-5.description: Contributed to internal systems using NestJS, ReactJS, and PostgreSQL. Prepared technical documentation and supported testing and deployment.

exp-6.description: Managed servers, networks, and workstations. Maintained the company website and internal systems and proposed IT solutions to support operations.
